Academics

Projects

Things I've built, with what worked and what I learned.

Tilt-steered robotic car with autonomous navigation

XLR8, Electronics and Robotics Club, IIT Bombay · August 2026
Raspberry Pi Pico WMPU-6050 IMUESP-01Ultrasonic sensorServo
  • Built for IIT Bombay's flagship robotics competition, which needed a custom-steered car to cross a 40 cm wide obstacle-filled track within a set time.
  • Designed and made the chassis and suspension, with manual steering that reads tilt from the IMU. A servo-mounted ultrasonic sensor handles obstacle detection when the bot is out of the driver's line of sight.
  • Went from concept to a working prototype in 10 days, and cleared 9 of 13 obstacles in the final run within 12 minutes.
  • It was my first engineering project: ten days of late nights debugging circuits and reworking the mechanical design.
